currentWork: MarkerPDF is supervised as a native PHP searchable-PDF parser/converter plus supplied-boundary review pipeline. This isolated patch covers object-stream filter-stack boundaries where a compressed object-stream carrier contains a valid explicit filter EOD followed by non-whitespace tail bytes. Native object-stream member expansion now requires bounded filter-stack ends before accepting xref type-2 page members, preserving direct page text while forcing malformed tailed carriers to remain unresolved and excluding both decoded compressed page text and post-EOD tail text from WordPress paragraphs. No Python, CUDA, OCR, model execution, multiprocessing, raster decoding, PDF action execution, decryption/password validation, or external PDF tools run.
blocker: No GPU/model execution will be run for markerPDF under current user direction. Therefore live OCR for scanned PDFs, Surya layout/reading-order/OCR/table-cell models, Texify equation recognition, Torch/model batching, Streamlit/FastAPI model workers, page-pixel visual table recognition, and exact upstream model benchmark parity are intentionally unavailable. The continuous refill watchdog is active for markerPDF/Pandoc workers; remaining in-scope markerPDF work is native searchable-PDF behavior and supplied-boundary conversion/review.
